brief: A modern corporate onboarding symbol: an open squared ultramarine office doorway with a single warm-ivory employee identity badge crossing the threshold. The badge bears only a simple sculpted human bust and two short recessed lines, no lettering. Three short orchid step-tabs integrate with the base, suggesting sequenced onboarding tasks. Compact dignified welcome into an organization, not a garden courtyard or real estate icon. Ultramarine #253CA5, porcelain ivory #F7F5EE and restrained orchid #B88AC8. No flags, palm trees, arches, handshake anatomy or approval check.
prompt: Create one original exceptionally clear premium mobile-app BRAND SYMBOL, with restrained dimensional ceramic/metal depth. Square canvas, fully transparent RGBA background, no wordmark, no letters, no numerals, no tile or backdrop. Clean confident silhouette with few broad forms; preserve readability at 48 px. Centered, longest extent around 72% of canvas with entirely transparent margins. Soft studio illumination, subtle depth, no ground plane shadow or debris. The picture must communicate the app's function directly.
